{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f'Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_patients.sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}')

# Check the distribution of arm and severity
tab_arm_severity = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'])
print('Cross-tabulation of arm vs severity:')
print(tab_arm_severity)

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
max_seq_per_patient = df_grouped['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Max sample_seq per patient: {max_seq_per_patient}')"}
